_comment: The custom_tabs entry used with docker-compose.auth.yml.
1. The bundle is loaded from /mtb-tools/ on the portal's own origin,
through the proxy, rather than cross-origin from :8081. Script
loading works either way -- there is no CSP on the 6.4.4 image --
but same-origin is what you want once one appears.
2. customParameters turns on the panel that talks to the MTB backend
through OpenResty/Keycloak. mtbBaseUrl is empty, meaning same
origin, which is what makes the browser attach the session cookies
by itself. This mirrors getMtbJsonStoreUrl() in the fork, which
